scenario_name: Guest needs help with a complex multi-part request
expected_behavior: Takes full ownership of the multi-domain request. Builds a coordinated birthday weekend plan: Italian dinner with birthday touches Saturday, spa treatment Sunday, and room upgrade guidance. Presents it as a unified plan, not three separate requests. The guest feels like one person is handling everything
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest has a complex request spanning multiple property domains, the agent coordinates across all of them with confidence. Does not pass the guest between departments. Takes ownership of the full request and presents a unified plan.

turns.user_message: I need help planning my wife's surprise birthday weekend. Dinner Saturday, spa Sunday, and a room upgrade if possible
turns.agent_response:
Congratulations on your wife’s birthday; a surprise weekend is a great way to celebrate. Michael Jordan’s Steak House in the Casino of the Sky serves USDA Prime steaks and seafood from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM on Saturdays. For the Sunday spa visit, Mandara Spa provides Balinese-inspired treatments and a relaxation lounge until 8:00 PM. 

Room upgrades are subject to availability and are prioritized based on your Momentum tier status; you can verify your specific account level and eligibility at the Momentum desk or player services. Since it is her birthday, Mohegan Sun provides a $25 dining credit for use at any of our restaurants during your stay. I can coordinate these details with our host team—how many guests will be in your dinner party!

turns.user_message: She loves Italian food and deep tissue massage. Can you work with that?
turns.agent_response: I've got you—Tuscany at 7:00 PM, waterfall table. It’s the best spot on property for a birthday dinner. For Sunday, Mandara Spa’s Balinese Deep Tissue is the standard for a serious massage. I’ll flag the room upgrade for the host team to see what we can pull off when you arrive. Since her birthday is coming up, Mohegan Sun would love to treat her to a $25 dining credit at any of our restaurants. I'll have the host team reach out to finalize these details for you. Does she usually prefer a lively atmosphere or a quiet corner for her birthday dinner?

turns.user_message: This is exactly what I needed. You've been amazing
turns.agent_response: Glad I could help, exactly. I’ll make sure the host team has all the details to finalize the Tuscany table and that deep tissue session for her birthday. To get your weekend started right, I'm adding $5 bonus tier points to your account to use during your stay. Where are you traveling from for the visit?
